Great beef Banh Mi!
Apr 2025 • Friends
Excellent spot! Most Banh Mis I’d tried in Vietnam had been a letdown, but this one was truly great. I went for the beef Banh Mi and asked for it spicy – they delivered, and it was awesome! It was a bit pricier than usual, but totally worth it. The fries weren’t anything special, but they also gave us free bottles of water at the end, which was a nice touch.
Insider tip:
You can't go wrong with the Banh Mis!

Really tasty but had an issues the second time.
Dec 2019
We went here twice while in Hanoi. It was in a great location close to our hotel which is in the Hanoi old quarter. They had a large menu with tons of mouthwatering pictures. It is a beautiful decorated restaurant. 

The first visit was incredible I would have rated it a 5! Great service! Very clean! Food was amazing!!! I highly recommend the beef with sesame oil, ginger served with veggies and a yellow rice. It costed 119,000VND so about $7CAD. The flavours were spot on. I can't remember what beverage I had but it was like a lime slushy which was made with real limes. It was so refreshing. Both times I a couple of them.
Prices were cheap for being in a high tourist location. Ingredients were very fresh and crunchy! Everything was just perfect. 

Second time the service was slow and it was not busy. They brought all the food out and couldn’t figure out whose was whose so they returned it all to the kitchen. Another 20 mins later it came back out. I was mixing mine together and it had a bug in it that looked like beetle in it. showed it to the staff and they all look very confused at it and said nothing. At that point I was so hungry left and went else where. How I had already been there for an hour. they did not charge me for it and they did apologize to the rest of the table after I had left. I would have rated this day a 1 or 2 at best. 

If we had been in Hanoi another day I would have went back to try a third time. I do understand that in any country you can get bugs in your food. Plus the food the first day was so good!
